problem: Prepare a source-backed weekly status draft
scope: Local draft from approved reporting records

phases.name: Days 1–30
phases.focus: Choose one bounded task and measure a manual baseline
phases.exit_evidence: Owner, source, baseline records, and accepted-output rule

phases.name: Days 31–60
phases.focus: Run an approved read-only supervised trial
phases.exit_evidence: Paired time, accepted outputs, corrections, fallback, and stop logs

phases.name: Days 61–90
phases.focus: Review reliability, authority, full cost, and observed outcomes
phases.exit_evidence: Human continue, change, or retire decision with cited evidence
